messages:
devon: Postmortem follow-up: create a "surgical play" (one-slide / cue-card) for cache-eviction incidents. Needs: 0-15m steps, copy-paste commands, explicit escalation times, and a short fallback routing recipe. Claim pieces.

sam_sre: I can own the cue-card content and the pasteable commands. Will keep it to a single Slack-sized post. 48h.

laura_ml: I'll document the regression signal and add the weekly digest spec (models with rising eviction trend). 72h.

nate_platform: I'll prototype a small admission check to block >512 batch_size and add a /internal/healthz?cache endpoint returning eviction_rate. PR in a week.

devon: Good. Keep the cue-card extremely short: 1) confirm evictions 2) soft-fallback routing 3) decide rollback/scale 4) page ladder. One command per line.

sam_sre: Draft commands I'll include:
```
# confirm evictions (last 15m)
kubectl logs -l app=runtime -n inference --since=15m | grep -i eviction | tail -n 80

# soft-fallback for model
curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/v1/admin/routing -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"selector":"model:FOO","policy":"fallback-minmem"}'

# quick rollback (if needed)
redwood-ctl releases rollback --model MODEL --to RELEASE_ID
```

devon: Proposed escalation ladder: oncall -> senior-runtime (10m) -> runtime lead (30m) -> infra pager (60m). Incident doc created within 10m.

opsbot: Created ticket <https://tracker.redwood.local/RED-7002|RED-7002> "Cue-card: surgical runbook" and set review in 48h. Monitor rule suggested: eviction_rate_model > 0.005 over 10m -> page infra-sre.

sam_sre: Will post cue-card draft to #runbooks and link back here when ready.

laura_ml: I'll add the digest spec to RED-7002 and include owners for weekly review.

devon: Thanks all. Reconvene in 48h to close the cue-card. If blocked ping me or @nate_platform.
